title: Full-Stack .Net Developer
description:
Hello guys 👋

At Intobi, we're a software and product development company passionate about driving innovation and progress.

We help our clients succeed by delivering custom-built tech solutions designed to meet their unique needs.

Our expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Web and Mobile applications.

 

We’re looking for a success-driven Senior Full-Stack .NET Developer for one of our clients.

 

Full-Time, Long-Term position, work from the office or remote.

 

About the project:
This is an app for dental clinics. A team of developers, designers, DevOps specialists, and testers is working on the project.

 

Technical requirements:

— .NET Core, .NET 8 or later - 3+ years of experience;

— Angular 18 or later - 2+ years of experience or any other SPA frameworks like React or Vue - 3+ years of experience;

— Entity Framework Core - code first and database first approaches, understanding how EF and LINQ works under the hood;

— Experience working with MySQL or any other RDBMS;

— Distributed caching, distributed locks, Redis;

— Microservices, distributed system architecture design, scaling up vs scaling out;

— Deploying to AWS EBS and AWS ECS, experience writing CI/CD pipelines in YAML;

— Experience setting up metrics and telemetry, using OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Sentry or other monitoring tools;

— Writing integrations with API of 3rd party SaaS platforms (Xero, QuickBooks, Twilio, Stripe, or others);

— Knowledge of possible security threats in web development, supply-chain attacks on developers;

— Knowing what CORS is, how it works, and how to configure CORS correctly with dynamic list of allowed domains;

— Containers, writing Dockerfile, writing bash scripts;

— Knowing all of that without AI assistance;

— Being capable googling staff yourself.

 

Would be a plus:

— Writing integration with Xero or QuickBooks in particular;

— Creating custom NuGet packages and distributing them through private nuget feeds;

— No fear using "git rebase --interactice" and solving merge conflicts;

— Experience setting up IAM system (like Keycloak) and using it for user authentication and machine-to-machine authentication;

— Writing n8n or Zappier workflows to automate routine tasks;

— Knowing and using 3rd party tools to enchance development workflow: Code Rabbit, SonarQube, and others;

— Knowing how to configure AI to be most productive, and how to share this configuration with the team.

 

What we offer:

— Competitive salary;

— Paid vacation and sick leaves;

— 8 hours a working day, 5 days a week;

— Career growth potential;

— Friendly team and corporate events.

 

Please send your CV here or via email.

 

Should the first stage be successfully completed, you’ll be invited to a personal interview.
